sar.narrative: Customer C08106 (card C08106-K1) conducted a series of suspicious card-not-present transactions totaling $384.43 between December 28 and December 30, 2016. The flagged transaction 3583227 for $128.33 occurred online (product C, channel=online) with a risk score of 0.34 and originated from a new device identified as Firefox 47.0 with no proxy. The card_not_present_new_device pattern was detected with 0.65 confidence, driven by the transaction amount being 3.3 standard deviations above the customer's $35.31 baseline and eight online transactions within a 48-hour window. Customer C08106 has 216 lifetime transactions averaging $35.52, with primary billing region 284.0 and activity dating back to July 6, 2016. This activity is linked to four prior confirmed fraud cases on the same card (CC-2121: $102.68, CC-1736: $9.90, CC-3778: $58.42) and one similar confirmed fraud case on a different customer (CC-0223: $160.30), while case CC-0696 was cleared. The deviation from historical spending, use of a previously unseen device, high velocity of online purchases, and direct connection to multiple confirmed fraud incidents on this card establish the suspicious nature of the activity. In response, case HHG-004 was created automatically, a Level 2 report was filed, and the card was blocked at Level 1.
